origin: Allowlisted extraction from each selected original C4 run.json; each raw hash matched the canonical export. Unknown controls were not reconstructed from current source code.
notes: Exact sampling, reasoning and output settings were not retained per request. The model ID alone does not prove equivalent requests.
C4 records declare disabled task network access; actual Docker egress enforcement was not attested per historical run.
CPU, memory, storage and process limits were not recorded as enforced limits. Host RAM is not a per-container memory limit.
Provider-side cache state and reset policy were not controlled or recorded. Observed cache tokens remain valid usage measurements.
Harness-specific tools, system prompts and context management remain native harness behavior. They are not normalized away.
